title: NPD Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced
**NPD Manager**
to drive innovation and product development in the food and nutrition segment. The role involves managing the end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle, from concept development and formulation to commercialization and product launch, with a focus on nutrition, taste, quality, food safety, and market demand.

The candidate will lead the development of products such as
**protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other innovative food and nutrition products**
, ensuring regulatory compliance and commercial viability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and launch innovative food and nutrition products, including
  **protein bars, protein powders, nutritional spreads, breakfast cereals, and other functional food products**
  .
* Manage the complete NPD lifecycle, from ideation and formulation to trials, scale-up, commercialization, and market launch.
* Ensure products meet nutritional requirements, taste expectations, quality standards, and consumer preferences.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations, food safety standards, and product labelling requirements.
* Identify and evaluate new ingredients, functional ingredients, suppliers, and packaging materials.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trials, and sensory evaluations to improve product formulations.
* Collaborate with R&D, production, quality assurance, procurement, and marketing teams to ensure successful product launches.
* Optimize product formulations and manufacturing costs while maintaining product quality and nutritional value.
* Oversee product trials, shelf-life studies, stability testing, and manufacturing scale-up.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, product performance, and commercialization milestones.
* Keep up to date with emerging trends in kids’ nutrition, functional foods, protein-based products, and health-focused FMCG categories.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own channel and distributor marketing, manage our external agency ecosystem, and coordinate execution across our marketing function. You'll work directly with the CMO, with high visibility into company wide GTM strategy and real room to grow as our marketing org scales.

This is a hands on execution role for someone who wants ownership early in their career, not a role for someone looking to manage a large team from day one.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own distributor and channel marketing: partner kits, onboarding packs, territory launch plans, and co-marketing programs
* Build and maintain our sales and marketing collateral library, including datasheets, brochures, decks, case studies, and ROI tools
* Manage our advertising, PR, and influencer marketing agencies, covering briefing, budgets, timelines, and quality of deliverables
* Lead PR agency coordination specifically: media outreach, press releases, and journalist/analyst engagement
* Coordinate influencer campaigns end to end, from agency briefing through performance tracking
* Act as the coordination point across Digital Marketing, Creative Studio, and channel initiatives, tracking status, flagging risks, and keeping execution aligned to plan
* Apply brand standards consistently across partner, agency, and product facing materials
* Support product launches, trade shows, events, and live demos

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**
*(List must-have skills, technical expertise, certifications, etc.)*

* 5 to 7 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally with a tangible product company (industrial, hardware, robotics, automation, medtech, or capital equipment)
* Hands on experience building sales and marketing collateral for B2B sales cycles
* Working knowledge of distributor/dealer channel mechanics
* Experience managing external agencies, advertising and/or influencer marketing, including briefing, budgets, and deliverable review
* Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to synthesize status across multiple workstreams

**Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):**

* PR agency management experience. This is a capability we're actively building, and candidates with direct experience here stand out
* Experience managing a digital marketing team
* International GTM or distributor exposure
* Background in robotics, automation, or tangible product company
* MBA or PGDM in Marketing

**What You'll Get**

* Direct access to the CMO and visibility across the entire marketing function
* Ownership of channel marketing and the agency ecosystem at a growing NSE listed company
* Exposure to international GTM and C suite level marketing operations
* A clear growth path: strong performers will be considered for Senior Marketing Manager within 12 months

**Educational Qualification:**

MBA Marketing or equivalent experience in the marketing field.

* Engineering background preferred.

description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.
